reason: Measured first-shard partial raw-wikitext prototype exceeded a naive 22 GB extrapolation; duplicate page IDs and a slow primary monthly download also invalidated initial assumptions.
status: provisional adaptation, must measure complete shard and final installed bytes

pageviews.rule: Sum exact stored title counts; match literal lowercase underscore title; missing observations remain NULL

canonical_rule: Highest revision ID per page ID across all pinned shards, then source shard and row ascending; highest revision per conflicting title, page ID ascending tie break; latest ineligible record does not silently fall back to older text
supplement_rule: Full original wikitext always retained in immutable source Parquet; installed full wikitext retained for all recognized notice candidates, has_math articles, or raw math/convert/cvt/val/physconst markup; structured infobox extraction retained for every article
limits: Notice heuristics and unknown templates do not establish complete rights clearance; distribution_ready=false; source body/math/units counterexamples must be inspected
preserve: Initial protocol, full-wikitext pilot, monthly partial bytes, all failed attempts and raw query outcomes are preserved
